name: RealEdge Exchange MAX-128
shortDescription: High-capacity edge server for up to 128 channels with up to 96TB archive.
fullDescription: High-capacity edge server for recording/processing up to 128 channels with up to 96TB archive (HDDs sold separately). Features 1U rackmount design, Intel Core Ultra 9 processor, 32GB RAM, 512GB OS drive, (1) RTX 2000 ADA and a PCIe slot for GPU/RAID. Ideal for enterprise-scale deployments in retail/logistics, enabling seamless edge-to-cloud AI compute and hybrid workflows without vendor lock-in.

name: RealEdge Exchange AIO-8
shortDescription: All-in-one NVR with built-in 8-port PoE switch for up to 16 channels.
fullDescription: All-in-one NVR with built-in 8-port PoE switch for up to 16 channels and 24TB archive (HDDs sold separately). 1U rackmount with Intel Core Ultra 9 processor, 16GB RAM, 256GB OS, and PCIe slot for expansion of AI acceleration. Simplifies setups for small-to-medium sites, supporting serverless AI and direct cloud integration.

name: RealEdge Exchange Mini-2TB
shortDescription: Compact AI bridge server powered by NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano for up to 16 channels.
fullDescription: Compact AI bridge server for up to 16 channels, powered by NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano (8GB). Includes 2TB built-in archive and runs RealVue plus RealIntelligence models simultaneously. Perfect for edge deployments in space-constrained environments, delivering low-power, high-performance analytics.

name: RealEdgeCAM VSS-FT
shortDescription: 5MP Turret IP Camera for video-only surveillance.
fullDescription: 5MP Turret IP Camera for video-only surveillance. Supports 30fps at 5MP, H.265/H.264/MJPEG compression, True WDR, 3D DNR, ROI, HLC, BLC, Defog, and Smart IR up to 30m. Reliable for basic monitoring in retail/transport settings.

name: RealEdgeCAM AI5-FD
shortDescription: 5MP IR Dome AI IP Camera with STARVIS sensor – serverless AI.
fullDescription: 5MP IR Dome AI IP Camera with STARVIS sensor. 30fps at 5MP (upgradable to 8MP), H.265/H.264/MJPEG, True WDR, Smart IR up to 30m, and MicroSD slot for serverless/trickle storage. Hosts RealVue and RealIQ analytics on-device for privacy-first, edge-powered intelligence.
notes: Serverless AI Camera - Can host all RealVue and Real-IQ SKUs. MicroSD priced separately

name: RealEdgeCAM AI8-MB
shortDescription: 4K IR Bullet AI IP Camera – fully hosts RealVue/RealIQ on-device.
fullDescription: 4K IR Bullet AI IP Camera with STARVIS sensor. 30fps at 8MP, H.265/H.264/MJPEG, True WDR, 3D DNR, Smart IR up to 40m, and MicroSD for storage. Fully hosts RealVue/RealIQ SKUs, enabling serverless AI workflows in harsh environments.
notes: Serverless AI Camera - Can host all RealVue and Real-IQ SKUs. MicroSD priced separately

name: RealEdgeCAM AI5-360
shortDescription: 5MP Compact IR Fisheye AI IP Camera for 360° panoramic views.
fullDescription: 5MP Compact IR Fisheye AI IP Camera for panoramic views (360/180°). 5MP resolution, H.265/H.264/MJPEG, STARVIS True WDR (120dB), 3D DNR, Smart IR up to 25m, and MicroSD storage. Supports on-device RealVue/RealIQ for comprehensive coverage without additional servers.
notes: Serverless AI Camera - Can host all RealVue and Real-IQ SKUs. MicroSD priced separately

name: RealTrack – Advanced Object Tracking
shortDescription: State-of-the-art deep learning for precise tracking of people, vehicles, bags, and custom objects.
fullDescription: Advanced Object Tracking Analytics – leverages state-of-the-art deep learning for precise tracking and classification of people, vehicles, bags, and custom objects, reducing false alarms while generating rich metadata for business intelligence. Supports tamper detection, enter/exit, dwell, loitering, counting, abandoned objects, aggressive behavior, fall detection, and logical rules.
notes: Behavior, weapon, PPE and Queue analytics are sold in separate tracking packages.

name: RealPlate – License Plate & Vehicle Recognition
shortDescription: >99% accuracy LPR/OCR for North American plates, trailers, containers, DOT numbers.
fullDescription: High-Performance License Plate and Vehicle Recognition – delivers industry-leading OCR with >99% accuracy for North American plates, trailer/container IDs, DOT numbers, and more, even at speeds up to 225 km/h. Provides comprehensive vehicle classification including make, model, color, pose, and type.
notes: OCR, Trailer and Container models sold in separate packages.

name: RealFace – Precision Facial Recognition
fullDescription: Precision Facial Recognition Analytics – delivering high-accuracy facial recognition with >95% profile matching, real-time detection powered by deep learning, and demographic insights including age and gender estimation. Users can create custom profiles and groups (VIP, staff, persons of interest).

name: RealSearch – Rapid Forensic Search & Re-Identification
shortDescription: Lightning-fast post-event investigations with metadata filters and image-based search.
fullDescription: Rapid Forensic Search & Re-Identification – delivers lightning-fast post-event investigations by indexing detailed metadata from all cameras in real time. Users can launch precise metadata filters or intuitive image-based searches using uploaded photos or detected objects, with iterative refinement for superior accuracy.

name: RealVue – Enterprise Video Management
shortDescription: Lightweight VMS optimized for embedded IoT appliances, IP cameras, and server-class machines.
fullDescription: Enterprise Video Management for Modern Video Intelligence – a lightweight media server optimized for embedded IoT appliances, IP cameras, and server-class machines. Seamlessly integrates 99% of IP cameras (over 45,000 devices supported) into a single, intuitive cross-platform client.
notes: Subscription fees are quoted as a monthly rate, sold in 12, 36, 60, 120 month commitments. All subscription agreements are billed annually in advance.
